item.text: {"threshold_rule":{"verbatim_text":"Solo las universidades del Estado con un mínimo de acreditación institucional de nivel avanzado de cinco años tendrán la atribución de reconocer y revalidar","source_url":"https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/navegar?idNorma=1221526","required_years":5,"required_level":"avanzado","state_only":true,"interpretation":"Decreto 174/2024, artículo 5, therefore restricts recognition/revalidation of foreign professional titles and academic degrees to state universities with five-year advanced institutional accreditation; accreditation of excellence for six or seven years necessarily exceeds that minimum. Article 4 adds subject-matter limits: “solo podrán reconocer y revalidar títulos y grados académicos correspondientes a carreras o programas afines a los que impartan” (https://nuevo.leychile.cl/servicios/Consulta/Exportar?exportar_con_notas_al_pie=True&exportar_con_notas_bcn=True&exportar_con_notas_originales=True&exportar_formato=pdf&hddResultadoExportar=1221526..0.0%23&nombrearchivo=Decreto-174_17-FEB-2026&radioExportar=Normas); the program must also have graduates, and an obligatorily accredited profession such as Medicina requires accreditation of that career. Article 7 says: “El procedimiento deberá publicarse en su sitio web institucional” (https://www.diariooficial.interior.gob.cl/publicaciones/2026/02/17/44378/01/2769106.pdf). Private institutions are not empowered for professional titles or academic degrees: article 6 only says they “podrán reconocer o revalidar títulos técnicos” (same Diario Oficial source). Consequently, no private university qualifies for this doctor’s medical title or PhD and none is included below. CUECH’s authoritative roster is headed “18 Universidades Estatales” (https://redartesyhumanidades.uestatales.cl/integrantes/) and enumerates: Universidad de Tarapacá; Universidad Arturo Prat; Universidad de Antofagasta; Universidad de Atacama; Universidad de La Serena; Universidad de Valparaíso; Universidad de Playa Ancha; Universidad Metropolitana de Ciencias de la Educación; Universidad de Santiago de Chile; Universidad de Chile; Universidad Tecnológica Metropolitana; Universidad de O’Higgins; Universidad de Talca; Universidad del Bío-Bío; Universidad de La Frontera; Universidad de Los Lagos; Universidad de Aysén; and Universidad de Magallanes. Applying the Part A split specified in the question, its five uncovered, non-Medicina institutions are UNAP, UPLA, UMCE, UTEM and Universidad de Aysén."},"universities":[{"name":"Universidad Arturo Prat","is_state":true,"accreditation_years":5,"accreditation_level":"Avanzado","accreditation_from":"2022-07-06","accreditation_until":"2027-07-06","meets_threshold":"yes","source_url":"https://www.unap.cl/prontus_unap/site/artic/20220708/pags/20220708150015.html","quote":"nivel avanzado por un periodo de 5 años […] desde el 06 de julio del 2022 al 06 de julio del 2027","has_published_revalidation_procedure":"no","revalidation_procedure_url":"","revalidation_notes":"No published Decreto 174 recognition/revalidation procedure found on UNAP’s official domain as of 2026-09-03. The published material is its ordinary Oficina de Títulos y Grados, whose official contact listing says “Títulos y Grados […] titulos-grados@unap.cl” (https://campus.unap.cl/buscador_personal/inicio); it is not a foreign-degree intake page. It therefore provides no published route for an applicant filing from Ukraine. It cannot presently revalidate Medicina: UNAP says its plans include “la apertura de la carrera de Medicina en 2027” (https://www.unap.cl/prontus_unap/site/artic/20260722/pags/20260722161021.html), so there is no graduating medical cohort. Institutionally, UNAP could potentially handle an affine PhD after establishing the required procedure, but no published procedure was found.","contact_email":"titulos-grados@unap.cl"},{"name":"Universidad de Playa Ancha","is_state":true,"accreditation_years":5,"accreditation_level":"Avanzado","accreditation_from":"2022-05-25","accreditation_until":"2027-05-25","meets_threshold":"yes","source_url":"https://www.upla.cl/noticias/2022/05/25/comision-nacional-de-acreditacion-acredito-a-la-universidad-de-playa-ancha-por-5-anos/","quote":"en el nivel Avanzado, por un periodo de 5 años, desde hoy hasta el 25 de mayo de 2027","has_published_revalidation_procedure":"no","revalidation_procedure_url":"","revalidation_notes":"No published Decreto 174 recognition/revalidation procedure found on UPLA’s official domain as of 2026-09-03. Its Títulos y Grados page describes an office for “tramitación de los títulos y grados que otorga la Universidad” and gives “titulosygrados@upla.cl” (https://www.upla.cl/titulosygrados/); that is not a foreign-degree intake process. No published route accepts applicants filing from abroad. It does not cover Medicina: its current official health-career listing names “Enfermería”, “Fonoaudiología” and “Kinesiología”, but no Medicina (https://www.upla.cl/admision/). An affine PhD might become legally processable if UPLA establishes a procedure and has the required graduate cohort, but no operating process was found.","contact_email":"titulosygrados@upla.cl"},{"name":"Universidad Metropolitana de Ciencias de la Educación","is_state":true,"accreditation_years":4,"accreditation_level":"Avanzado","accreditation_from":"2023-09-06","accreditation_until":"2027-09-06","meets_threshold":"no","source_url":"https://www.umce.cl/noticia/umce/universidad/umce-acreditacion-avanzada/","quote":"certificación de calidad para la UMCE de cuatro años […] hasta el 6 de septiembre de 2027, ubicándola en el tramo avanzado","has_published_revalidation_procedure":"no","revalidation_procedure_url":"","revalidation_notes":"No published foreign-title recognition/revalidation procedure found. UMCE fails article 5’s five-year institutional threshold, so it cannot accept this doctor’s professional-title or PhD file under Decreto 174, whether submitted in Chile or from abroad. The existing Títulos y Grados page concerns UMCE-issued awards and lists “titulos.grados@umce.cl” (https://www.umce.cl/admision/titulos-y-grados/); this is not a statutory Unidad Coordinadora or intake route. It does not offer a Medicina route.","contact_email":"titulos.grados@umce.cl"},{"name":"Universidad Tecnológica Metropolitana","is_state":true,"accreditation_years":4,"accreditation_level":"Avanzado","accreditation_from":"March 2026; exact day not found in the readable official source","accreditation_until":"March 2030; exact day not found in the readable official source","meets_threshold":"no","source_url":"https://fae.utem.cl/2026/03/27/utem-se-acredita-por-4-anos-y-anade-area-de-investigacion/","quote":"UTEM se acredita por 4 años […] acreditación institucional […] en nivel Avanzado, hasta marzo de 2030","has_published_revalidation_procedure":"no","revalidation_procedure_url":"","revalidation_notes":"No published foreign-title recognition/revalidation procedure found. UTEM’s institutional accreditation is advanced but only four years, below article 5’s minimum; it cannot accept the medical-title or PhD application from Chile or abroad. Its published certification contact is attached to “Constancia de Título en Trámite” and says “E-mail: certificacion@utem.cl” (https://www.utem.cl/guia-de-tramites/unidad-de-titulos-y-grados/certificados-y-otros-documentos/constancia-de-titulo-en-tramite/); this concerns UTEM’s own awards, not foreign revalidation. It does not offer a Medicina route.","contact_email":"certificacion@utem.cl"},{"name":"Universidad de Aysén","is_state":true,"accreditation_years":3,"accreditation_level":"Básico","accreditation_from":"2023-04-12","accreditation_until":"2026-04-12 formal term; legally extended while the 2026 reaccreditation proceeding remains unresolved","meets_threshold":"no","source_url":"https://dfi.mineduc.cl/wp-content/uploads/sites/114/2026/01/URY2457_DEC-149-2024_aprueba-conv-AIUE-Calidad-URY-UTA.pdf","quote":"en el nivel básico por un plazo de tres años, desde el 12 de abril de 2023 al 12 de abril de 2026","has_published_revalidation_procedure":"no","revalidation_procedure_url":"","revalidation_notes":"No published foreign-title recognition/revalidation procedure found. Although the formal three-year term expired, article 16 bis provides that the existing accreditation “se prorrogará hasta la dictación de la resolución final que ponga término al proceso” (https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/Navegar/imprimir?idNorma=1118991&idParte=0&idVersion=2024-11-02). The reaccreditation was still unresolved: on 2026-08-31 UAysén reported that external reviewers would visit from 1–4 September (https://uaysen.cl/2026/08/31/comunicado-visita-comite-de-pares-evaluadores-de-la-cna/; quote: “recibiremos al Comité de Pares Evaluadores de la Comisión Nacional de Acreditación”). The extended accreditation remains basic and three-year, so UAysén does not meet article 5 and cannot accept the doctor’s medical-title or PhD file from anywhere. No Medicina route exists in this Part B institution. Its general official contact is “Oficina de Partes: partes@uaysen.cl” (https://estudiantes.uaysen.cl/), not a published revalidation unit.","contact_email":"partes@uaysen.cl"}],"bottom_line":"As of 3 September 2026, none of these five state universities has published a working foreign professional-title or academic-degree intake process, and no private university is legally empowered for a doctor’s professional title or PhD. UNAP and UPLA clear the institutional threshold but have not opened a public procedure; the other three fail the threshold, while none of the five can presently handle Medicina. Universidad de Chile therefore remains, in practice, the only verified working route. Its live portal expressly offers the steps “Crear una ‘Cuenta Uchile’” and “Completar el formulario de solicitud” (https://ucampus.uchile.cl/m/prorrectoria_revalidacion_postulacion/), and its Medicina faculty publishes a “Procedimiento de Revalidación de la Facultad de Medicina” (https://medicina.uchile.cl/informacion-extranjeros/revalidacion-y-reconocimiento-de-titulos/procedimientos-para-revalida-y-reconocimiento-de-titulos). She may identify herself with “Cédula de identidad chilena o pasaporte” (https://uchile.cl/presentacion/relaciones-internacionales/revalidacion-de-titulos-extranjeros/revalidacion-y-reconocimiento-de-titulos), but this is not wholly remote: UChile requires a later “cita de ingreso y verificación de documentos originales” and says “Este pago debe ser realizado en pesos chilenos desde una cuenta chilena” (https://uchile.cl/presentacion/relaciones-internacionales/revalidacion-de-titulos-extranjeros/etapas-del-proceso). Thus she can realistically start only with UChile, arranging a Chilean-account payment and eventual attendance or a properly empowered third party.","unknowns":["Absence of a published webpage cannot exclude an unpublished pilot or an internal procedure under development at UNAP or UPLA; neither offers a publicly verifiable filing route today.","UTEM’s readable current official pages report March 2026–March 2030 but do not expose the exact start and end days. No later public result extending it to five years was found.","Universidad de Aysén’s new CNA decision had not been issued by 2026-09-03; the existing basic accreditation is legally extended until that final decision.","UChile accepts a passport and online document upload, but its public pages do not expressly state that no Chilean visa or residence status is required. They do establish that original-document verification must later occur in person, personally or through a properly authorized third party."]}
